subject: ADR-182: a path is placed by its box -- read-report reports each path's box, counts every command that ends somewhere, rounds and skips unplaced marks; the lab's workbench charts held to a port of barChart
body: THE LAB'S BARS, READ. ADR-140's reader placed marks by cx or x + width/2 and counted a path's points as its Ms and Ls; the ecology lab draws every bar as a rounded path (M V Q H Q V Z) under a transparent hit-rect and its survivorship line with H and V, so its sixteen readable charts came back as rows of hit-rects at one y with no bar height anywhere, a step line as one point, an unplaced hover dot as [null, null], a rect centre as 58.050000000000004. read-report now reports `spans` per path (the box of every point a command ends at, absolute or relative, control points left out, rounded), counts every command that ends somewhere in `longest`, rounds a rect's centre and leaves an unplaced mark out of `at` while `marks` still counts it. verify_report 120 (theBars fixture: absolute bar, relative twin, step line, 0.1 + 0.2 rect, unplaced circle), mutate_report 75/75 (+6, two anchors moved). The lab task holds wb-field-out and wb-quad-out to a Python port of barChart fed from its own typed counts (202 -> 211); verify_eco 143 types the same into the live page, parses each path's d and holds the page and the task to the port. Every page task 44/44 held under the new reader. No page was edited.
